cases.name: Snowborn Simulacra
cases.text: Conjure a duplicate of each of X target nontoken permanents into your hand. Those cards perpetually gain "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell." If X is 5 or more, you may put one of them from your hand onto the battlefield.
